text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Sprinters Stakes! I'm 
gonna go all out and make my mark on this 
Nakayama track, big time!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios is totally fired up too! But the 
one taking the sprint crown is—ME!! I'm 
not givin' this up to anyoneーー!
